result.instructions: Tools for ikas, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are waiting for shipment today?"; "Find the customer with the email address on order 1042 and show their recent orders."; "Which products have a SKU starting with the one I give you, and how much stock do they have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ikas data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ikas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ikas_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ikas_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ikas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ikas_get_app
tools.title: Get the app
tools.description: Confirm the connection: return the ikas Private App's id (the `me` query). A cheap way to check the store credentials work. ikas: POST /api/v1/admin/graphql { me { id } }.

tools.name: ikas_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the store's products (name, type, total stock, brand, categories, tags and variants with SKU and barcodes). Filters are exact matches. ikas: listProduct.

sku.description: Exact SKU of a product's variant.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-50 (default 20). The result says whether more pages exist (hasNext).

tools.name: ikas_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with their package status, payment status, total, order date and customer id. Filters are exact matches. Orders contain customer data: read only what the request needs. ikas: listOrder.

customerEmail.description: Exact customer email on the order.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-50 (default 20). The result says whether more pages exist (hasNext).

tools.name: ikas_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the store's customers (name, email, phone). Use `search` for a free-text search, or exact filters. Customers hold personal data: read only what the request needs. ikas: listCustomer.

search.description: Free-text search over the customer fields.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-50 (default 20). The result says whether more pages exist (hasNext).
